title: Horse Tracks: Nix, Broncos ready to test progress in preseason opener

sources.name: Yahoo Sports NFL
sources.title: Horse Tracks: Nix, Broncos ready to test progress in preseason opener
sources.description: Good morning, Broncos Country! Just a few short days until the Broncos get to compare their progress toward the 2026 season against guys in a different jersey, and no one is looking forward to it more than Bo Nix. “I’m excited,” the third-year quarterback said after practice yesterday. “I think preseason’s always a great time […]
